exposure: Prenatal weight gain counseling according to 2009 Institute of Medicine guidelines
cohort: 1571 pregnant women receiving prenatal care at seven family medicine residency clinics
finding: Improved prenatal weight gain counseling was associated with a significant reduction in the incidence of gestational diabetes but did not significantly affect other obstetric outcomes.
mod_finding: While the study found no significant differences in mode of delivery (cesarean section) based on weight gain counseling, it did observe a decrease in gestational diabetes with improved counseling.
